title: Colors Song for Kids! Learn Colors with Bloop the Jelly Blob
description:
The Colors Song for kids! Sing along with Bloop the jelly blob, who changes color with every word: red, yellow, orange, green, blue and purple.
Kids learn their colors, color mixing (blue + yellow = green) and the rainbow. Ages 2-5.

LYRICS
Red, red, apple red!
Bloop is red, red, red!
Yellow, yellow, sunny sun!
Yellow banana, yum, yum, yum!
Colors, colors, look at me!
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colors, colors, sing with me!
Orange, orange, juicy treat!
Orange carrots, good to eat!
Green, green, froggy green!
Green grass, green leaf, green bean!
Clap, clap! Clap your hands!
Stomp, stomp! Stomp your feet!
Jump, jump! Jump up high!
Spin around and wave hi!
Blue, blue, sky so blue!
Blue, blue, the ocean too!
Purple, purple, grapes for me!
Purple flowers, one, two, three!
Red, orange, yellow, green,
Blue and purple, what a team!
All the colors, look and see,
Make a rainbow, you and me!

title: Yummy Fruits Song for Kids! Eat Your Rainbow with Pipkiko
description:
The Yummy Fruits Song for kids! Sing along with Pipkiko the strawberry and her fruit and veggie friends: apple, banana, carrot and broccoli.
Kids learn fun true food facts, colors of the rainbow and to wash fruits and veggies before eating. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Yummy fruits, crunchy veggies, eat your rainbow!
Red and orange, yellow, green, yum yum yum!
Munch munch, crunch crunch, healthy and strong!
I'm Pipkiko, a strawberry, red and sweet!
Tiny seeds on the outside, count them, wow!
About two hundred seeds on every one!
Strawberry, strawberry, yum yum yum!
Crunchy apple, shiny red, crunch crunch crunch!
Drop an apple in the water, look, it floats!
Apples float, they have lots of air inside!
Apple, apple, yum yum yum!
Yellow banana, peel it down, peel peel peel!
Bananas grow in bunches called a hand!
Each banana is a finger, one, two, three!
Banana, banana, yum yum yum!
Orange carrot, long and crunchy, munch munch munch!
Carrots grow down under the ground!
Pull it up, pull it up, here it comes!
Carrot, carrot, yum yum yum!
Clap your hands, clap clap clap!
Stomp your feet, stomp stomp stomp!
Spin around and jump jump jump!
Wave hello to all your friends!
Green broccoli looks like a tiny tree!
The little bumps are flowers you can eat!
Tiny trees, tiny trees, chomp chomp chomp!
Broccoli, broccoli, yum yum yum!

title: Fire Truck Song for Kids! Wee-oo with Bolt the Fire Truck
description:
The Fire Truck Song for kids! Sing along with Bolt the fire truck and his truck friends in Tiny Truck Town.
Kids learn what fire trucks do: ladders, hoses, sirens and lights, and how firefighters stay safe. Count 1 to 4, then clap, stomp and jump along. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Fire truck, fire truck, big and red!
Ladder up and hoses spray!
Wee-oo, wee-oo, clear the way!
Fire truck, fire truck, saves the day!
Up, up, up goes the ladder,
Up so high into the sky!
Count the steps: one, two, three, four!
Firefighters climb up high!
Here's the hose, it's long and strong,
Water from the hydrant comes along!
Spray, spray, spray it high and low,
Whoosh! The water starts to flow!
Clap, clap! Clap your hands with me!
Stomp, stomp! Stomp like a big truck!
Jump, jump! Jump up, one, two, three!
Honk, honk! Beep, beep! Here we go!
See the lights go flash, flash, flash,
Hear the siren: wee-oo, wee-oo!
Cars move over, make some room,
Fire truck's coming, zoom, zoom, zoom!
Helmets, boots and big strong coats,
Firefighters stay safe and warm!
Thank you, thank you, brave and kind,
Firefighters help all the time!
Wee-oo, wee-oo! Bye-bye, fire truck!
Wee-oo, wee-oo, bye-bye, fire truck

title: The Planets Song for Kids! 8 Planets with Gizmo the Robot
description:
The Planets Song for kids! Sing all 8 planets in order with Gizmo the robot: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
Kids learn one true fact about each planet and the Sun. Ages 3-7. Blast off and sing along!

LYRICS
Beep boop! Hi, I'm Gizmo!
Let's sing the Planets Song!
Mercury, Mercury, closest to the Sun,
Tiny and speedy, zoom, zoom, zoom!
Venus, Venus, hottest one of all,
Thick clouds hide it, hot, hot, hot!
Earth, Earth, our home sweet home,
Water, plants, and you and me!
Eight planets spinning round the Sun,
Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars,
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune,
Eight planets spinning round the Sun!
Mars, Mars, the dusty red one,
Rusty dust makes Mars look red!
Jupiter, Jupiter, biggest of them all,
A giant storm, the Great Red Spot!
Saturn, Saturn, with the shiny rings,
Rings of ice and rock go round!
Clap, clap! Clap your hands!
Spin, spin, like a planet!
Jump, jump, reach the stars!
Three, two, one, blast off!
Uranus, Uranus, spinning on its side,
Tipped way over, rolling like a ball!
Neptune, Neptune, farthest from the Sun,
Deep blue, windy, and so cold!
Eight planets, now you know them all!
Let's all sing it, everyone!
Bye bye! Sing it again tomorrow!

title: Time for Bed Song for Kids! Bedtime Routine with Luna
description:
Time for Bed, Sleepyhead! A calm bedtime routine song for kids, with Luna the sleepy owl and her friends.
Sing along: bath time, brushing teeth, pajamas, a story, a big hug and goodnight. A gentle lullaby to help little ones wind down. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Time for bed, sleepyhead,
Moon is glowing, stars are bright,
Snuggle down in your cozy bed,
Time for bed, sleepyhead, goodnight.
Splash and splash in the warm bath,
Bubbles float up, pop, pop, pop!
Brush, brush, brush our little teeth,
Up and down and round and round.
One arm in, and two arms in,
Our pajamas, soft and warm.
Pick a book and snuggle close,
Turn the pages, one, two, three.
Wave goodnight to the moon and stars,
Yawn so big and stretch up slow.
Sleep helps you grow big and strong,
Rest your head and hum along.
Big warm hug, a squeeze so tight,
Kiss goodnight and dim the light.
Teddy's here, the night light glows,
Close your eyes now, nice and slow.
Sweet dreams, sleepyhead, goodnight.

title: Weather Song for Kids! Sunny, Rainy, Windy with Gizmo
description:
The Weather Song for kids! Sing along with Gizmo the robot and learn sunny, rainy, windy and snowy weather.
Kids learn simple weather facts (rain helps plants grow, wind is moving air, snowflakes are made of ice) and act out each kind of weather. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
What's the weather, weather today?
Look outside and you can say!
Sunny, rainy, windy, snow,
What's the weather? Here we go!
Sunny, sunny, the sun is out,
Warm and bright, we run about!
Wear your hat and drink water too,
The sun gives light to me and you!
Rainy, rainy, drip, drop, drip,
Clouds are full, the raindrops slip!
Boots and umbrella, splash, hooray,
Rain helps flowers grow each day!
Windy, windy, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh,
Leaves are dancing, see them go!
Wind is air that moves, you know,
Kites fly high when the wind blows!
Snowy, snowy, cold and white,
Snowflakes falling, soft and light!
Every snowflake, tiny and new,
Is made of ice, it's really true!
Sunny, stretch your arms up high!
Rainy, wiggle fingers, drip, drop, drip!
Windy, sway from side to side!
Snowy, shiver, brrr, and freeze!
Sunny, rainy, windy, snow! Bye-bye, friends!
What's the weather?
What's the weather today?
Look outside and you can see
Sunny rainy windy snow
Here we go
Bye bye friends
